fixed_meter_status: Four analytic context/interval proofs exclude realized-fixed coordinates; no meter derivative measured. Zero representatives are not identified sensitivity.

metric_definitions.count_weighted_sign_agreement: sum over owners of matching eligible basis signs / sum eligible basis counts; not mean of owner percentages
metric_definitions.magnitude_weighted_sign_agreement: sum abs(exact external delta) for matching signs / sum abs(exact external delta) for eligible bases
metric_definitions.mae: sum abs(estimated-exact external delta) / 69 measured bases
metric_definitions.aggregate_relative_l1: sum abs(estimated-exact external delta) / sum abs(exact external delta), not mean of owner ratios
metric_definitions.ranking: Ascending cost on same owner basis moves plus HOLD=0; no search over combinations, feasibility filtering, dual terms, channel weights or GNE solve
metric_definitions.local_plus_external: Exact local cost change from each measured secant + exact or estimated external cost change. Unit external weight only; this is a diagnostic cost comparison, not final follower utility.
metric_definitions.timing: SPSA pair wall times sum disjoint pair scopes; exact preparation includes candidate generation, shared response and price fit. SPSA reused exact basis and already initialized pool; these are not cold-start alternatives or full decisions.
